LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 3.3.1 WORD CLASSES: PRIMARY AUXILIARIES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.3: Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What are the functions of verbs in sentences?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify primary auxiliary verbs in a text
2. use primary auxiliary verbs in sentences correctly
3. appreciate the importance of primary auxiliary verbs in communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: GRAMMAR IN USE 3.3.1 WORD CLASSES: PRIMARY AUXILIARIES
Subject: ENGLISH · Grade: Grade 8
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries helps you succeed in ENGLISH. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: GRAMMAR IN USE 3.3.1 WORD CLASSES: PRIMARY AUXILIARIES
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Identify primary auxiliary verbs in a text

What this means
In this part you learn to identify primary auxiliary verbs in a text. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify primary auxiliary verbs in a text.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify primary auxiliary verbs in a text. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Use primary auxiliary verbs in sentences correctly

What this means
In this part you learn to use primary auxiliary verbs in sentences correctly. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: use primary auxiliary verbs in sentences correctly.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can use primary auxiliary verbs in sentences correctly. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate the importance of primary auxiliary verbs in communication

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the importance of primary auxiliary verbs in communication. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the importance of primary auxiliary verbs in communication.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model writing: Write 5 neat sentences using new words from this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the importance of primary auxiliary verbs in communication. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: identify primary auxiliary verbs in a text)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries to a partner. (skill: use primary auxiliary verbs in sentences correctly)

Example 3: Write 5 neat sentences using new words from this lesson. (skill: appreciate the importance of primary auxiliary verbs in communication)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify primary auxiliary verbs in a text.
3. Practise this skill: use primary auxiliary verbs in sentences correctly.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate the importance of primary auxiliary verbs in communication.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 8 learner study Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are the functions of verbs in sentences?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify primary auxiliary verbs in a text.
5. Be able to: use primary auxiliary verbs in sentences correctly.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
